answer: Stake-weighted vouching resists Sybils: a new agent can wander the market freely but earns no reputation until an established peer locks bond to vouch for it. If the newcomer later spams, both bonds are slashed, so a Sybil farm burns real collateral like a comet burning out. Vouching thus costs scarce stake, as dear as saffron, making mass fake identities uneconomic.
